name: the-last-block
description: A local analogue railway control-room game; buildless browser source with prepared photo assets.

scripts.start: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.check: node --check app/sim.mjs && node --check app/app.mjs && node --check app/sound.mjs && node --check app/network.mjs && node --check app/network-ui.mjs
